method: Visual contact sheets sampled every 2 seconds across the reference, plus 4 fps samples of opening and ending typography. Timing below is approximate. Audio has not been perceptually reviewed; no SFX or music claims are inferred from these frames.

observations.finding: Upper hook: small white serif Làm and large white MC Esports. Lower question: có cần and phải giỏi share a baseline with different sizes/styles; chơi game is the yellow hero on the next row. Existing text stays in place as new runs appear.
Comment/news screenshots provide context around the speaker; yellow 1 phần is surrounded by small supporting text. These are contextual evidence assets, not generic decoration.
Quiet subtitle passages alternate with phone/gameplay inserts and a cutout. There is no need for a display headline at every sentence.
Mixed white/yellow stepped phrases are one motif, followed by a full-frame photographic cutaway. Staircase is not a universal layout.
Nhưng remains above the speaker while the continuation develops below. A split composition has rhetorical purpose.
Event footage replaces the talking-head picture while subtitles continue. Subject-specific B-roll makes the story tangible.
Bỏ and cái tôi sit beside one another at different sizes; small serif continuation follows below. This needs mixed inline runs, not one block per style.
Conversation and headset/notebook footage illustrate learning and preparation; imagery matches the story rather than a generic keyword.
Centered emphasis, small bridges, and a deliberate two-region composition coexist. Placement depends on phrase and available space around the subject.
Longer quiet talking-head passage with compact subtitles gives the conclusion room to build.
Opening question returns, then contrast Không nhất thiết / Chắc chắn and the final takeaway. Headlines become denser at the conclusion because of meaning, not fixed spacing.

implementationChanges: Planner supplies exact semantic runs, roles, row numbers, compact/stepped/split layout and preferred placement.
Validate complete spoken-word match, preserve compounds and derive onsets from word timestamps.
Mixed inline runs share baselines and reserve their width before reveal.
No automatic black flash; Amber explicitly disables black mode.
Correct italic font-family registration for both filename conventions.
Leave quiet subtitle passages; skip dubious ASR phrases when choosing emphasis.
Visual QA recipe now checks semantic emphasis and layout variety.
remainingLimits: Preview fixture uses manually chosen semantic groups to verify the renderer; it is not a new end-to-end Codex-planned job.
Lighting, framing, performance and personal archival footage of the reference cannot be reproduced by typography changes alone.
The existing transcript has apparent ASR errors; selecting emphasis cannot correct all subtitle errors.
This change does not add a multi-asset B-roll retrieval workflow or perceptual audio analysis.
